area: West Ham centre / Plaistow north-west: Portway with the Parliamentary Borough and Ward boundary, West Ham Park lodge and Rifle Range, Drill Hall and The Cedars, Richford Road, Liddington Road, Harberson Road, Plaistow Grove, Victoria Cottages, Ann Street, Park Road, Stork Road, West Road
method: Viewed all 9 sweep crops at 2x (anchors: r0c0 Urinal and 'Division of Parly. Boro. & Ward Bdy.'; r0c1 Lodge, D.F., Rifle Range; r0c2 Drill Hall, The Cedars, P.O; r1c0 RICHFORD ROAD, LIDDINGTON ROAD, HARBERSON ROAD; r1c1 two ROAD labels either side of open ground; r1c2 T ROAD and east ROAD; r2c0 PLAISTOW GROVE, VICTORIA COTTAGES, ANN STREET, ALMA TERRACE; r2c1 P.A.R.K ROAD, STOR..; r2c2 WEST R and PARK R.O). Contact sheets viewed: cs1 (6x, Portway figures), cs2 (12x, same), cs3 (6x, west-edge 26.2, 26.2, 27.4, 24.9, B.M.28.34, 28.6), cs4 (12x, same), cs5 and cs5nn (10x smooth and nearest-neighbour for B.M.28.34, 28.6, 28.2), cs6 (6x, Harberson Road group and 23.0), cs7 (12x, same), cs8 (6x, southern group and east edge), cs9 (12x, same), cs10 (8x, 22.1, 26.1, 19.7), marker sheet mk1 (all 28 positions boxed and checked; 27.4 triangle corrected by 7 px at 12x and 14.0 moved to its figure centre after the marker sheet). Every crop and sheet displayed when opened and has an anchor in my notes.
legibility: Good print. The dash-dot Parliamentary Borough / Ward boundary along Portway carries dots and ticks that sit right against the figures, so most Portway figures are placed at their centre. Italic 6/8 on B.M.28.34 disagrees between smoothed and blocky zooms (low). Lone final 3s and 8s (26.3, 20.3, 19.8) are low by the guide rule. No sheet join seen by eye or reported by the tool.
